technology_name: AUTOMATED ROBOTIC SYSTEM FOR CLEANING OF RAILWAY TRACKS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Autonomous Service Robot / Railway Maintenance Rig
problem_solved: Manual sanitation of ballast railway tracks at active transit stations introduces extreme train-strike safety hazards, is highly unhygienic, and misses debris trapped in ties.
description: An autonomous railway maintenance vehicle system built with a heavy-duty structural base frame, a track-riding motorized wheel axle loop, a sliding mechanical link, a folding linkage frame arm, a rotating debris sweeping head, and a vacuum collector module.
applications: Station platform track cleanup management, rapid transit subway line maintenance, industrial rail yard cleanup operations, and autonomous municipal railway service grids.
secondary_sector: Water, Environment & Waste Management, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
